description.value: Somewhere Else Cafe is a diner-style café in the Fraser Valley region of British Columbia, serving American comfort food including breakfast plates, burgers, sandwiches, and pancakes. Its broad all-day menu makes it a practical refuelling stop for touring cyclists passing through the area. The café operates seven days a week with extended hours on weekends.
